arg.name: image
arg.description: The image topic. Should be remapped to the name of the real image topic.

arg.name: use_camera_info
arg.description: Indicates that the camera_info topic should be subscribed to to get the default input_frame_id. Otherwise the frame from the image message will be used.

arg.name: debug_view
arg.description: Specify whether the node displays a window to show the foreground mask

arg.name: queue_size
arg.description: Specify queue_size of input image subscribers

arg.name: method
arg.description: Background subtraction method, 0: MOG2, 1: KNN, 2: MOG, 3: GMG, 4: CNT, 5: GSOC, 6: LSBP (MOG, GMG, CNT, GSOC and LSBP need the bgsegm module of opencv_contrib, otherwise MOG2 is used)

arg.name: learning_rate
arg.description: Learning rate of the background model, negative: automatically chosen, 0: not updated, 1: reinitialized from the last frame (CNT, GSOC and LSBP may still update the model at 0, and GMG, GSOC and LSBP do not reinitialize it at 1)
